instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep one request that arrived, as decided, and ask the owner who should act on it", and give it request; decision.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:take-a-request and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: request is what arrived: request_id, source_ref, atom_ref, text, origin_ref, optionally message_ref, content_revision and at.

4. It reads no store and keeps nothing: give it the rows it needs as records (each { id, type, value }, read from your own store: intake-origins, intake-owner, intake-request, owner-action-request). Write the keep rows it returns to your own store.
